summary: Every page needs at least one anchor placed above the main heading, named after a unique page title if possible, and more anchors can be added elsewhere.
questions: Where should I put the main anchor on an RST page?
How do I add an anchor in RST?

answer_card.title: Adding RST anchors
answer_card.answer_md:
Put at least one anchor above the main heading, ideally named after the page's unique title:
```text
.. _unique_page:
```
You can add more anchors elsewhere.
